## Know when monitoring needs attention

- See a visible monitoring warning when a provider, team, or repository cannot be checked, instead of mistaking cached deployments for a fresh all-clear.
- Keep your cached deployment rows during provider outages, with an honest last-successful-full-check timestamp in Settings.
- Refresh performs a full check, clears warnings after recovery, and respects the existing rate-limit cooldown even when only part of an account fails.
- GitHub discovery and newly discovered repository polling now preserve rate-limit responses too.
- Recent failed deployments keep headline priority so monitoring warnings do not hide a broken deploy.

**macOS 14 or later · Apple Silicon and Intel · Version 0.1.4 (build 5)**

Built from merged commit `6f4944c5ebfc906cbff4884e26ef5aff3b474603`. Developer ID signed, Apple-notarized, stapled, and Gatekeeper-verified. The attached `appcast.xml` carries the Sparkle-signed update enclosure.

DMG SHA-256: `80b6d707e13f30df4844e61f7bb0106d2d1aac01267ea0941fa58228f0f515c7`

Monitoring improvements: #2. Partial-response cooldown fix: #3.
Fixes a menu row that kept saying 'building' after the deploy had finished.
Updates itself from now on (Sparkle). Checks right after you push or open the menu, mutes failures older than a week, and picks new projects automatically.
Maintenance rebuild of 0.1.0 with the updated release tooling. No changes to the app itself.
